label: D2 after choosing a2, early in the episode (trials < ~40)
explanation: Reset-gate unit 27 is active mainly at D2 (80% of mass), almost only when the agent just chose a2 (in_action=2; action a2 holds 97% of mass), and only in the first ~40 trials of an episode (essentially silent after trial 50). It is also more active in episodes that started with S2 good. A smaller component (20% of mass) is at D1, mostly after a rewarded a2 trial. It is almost never active at GO. Only observed variables are used (action is known at D2). Precision is limited (about 0.46): many early a2 D2 steps stay inactive, and the value or reached state does not clean that up. Some of the strongest activations are at D2 after a1 choices (rare S2 or common S1), which this predicate misses. Adding the D1 after a rewarded a2 clause lifts mass recall to 0.94, but precision falls to 0.33.
